elements.label: Field settings gear icon on hovered row
Add to view tooltip under the Bucket toggle

pattern.description: The cursor travels down the Fields panel; each hovered row shows its description card to the left (Summary, Bucket, Comments) and then the cursor settles on the Bucket toggle, where the row highlights, a gear icon appears and an 'Add to view' tooltip pops below the toggle.
pattern.why_premium: Hover affordances are used as free on-screen captions: the description cards explain each field while the narration says 'quickly edit this view', and the motion ends on the exact control (Add to view) the next beat uses.

build_hint.gsap: Cursor path: tl.to('.cursor', {motionPath: [...rows], duration: 0.5, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); per hovered row: tl.set(card, {autoAlpha: 1}).set(card, {autoAlpha: 0}, '+=0.1'); on arrival: tl.to('.row-bucket', {backgroundColor: '#f7f8f9', duration: 0.05}).set('.gear', {autoAlpha: 1}, '<').fromTo('.tooltip', {autoAlpha: 0, y: -2}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.1, ease: 'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Derive the hovered row index from the interpolated cursor y (Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)); render that row's description card and highlight only while hovered; tooltip opacity interpolate over 3 frames after the cursor stops. No spring.

notes: The hover description cards are transient and absent from the settled end frame; b01 (union region) is used for them because it covers where they appeared. Several small energy spikes correspond to the cards swapping.
